acceptance: The refunds tool no longer declares refunds.clustering_hold and execute runs its four earlier rules without clustering_hold.
Even with a leftover stored refunds.clustering_hold value of true, the four Kestrel not_received refunds stay in the analyst queue and execute reads allow.
An analyst can execute a Kestrel not_received refund straight through to the processor.
KYC approve no longer runs linked_refund_hold, and a low-risk case whose customer has a Kestrel refund clears with an analyst.
The KYC approve rule order is pinned without linked_refund_hold.
